messages:
Priya: dropping a new compact mock for the Usage & Billing view. main change: invoice list collapsed to a single row + overdue badge. PTAL :eyes:
Dan: quick thought 12 12: collapsing is fine but we need to make the badge more visible on small screens. maybe a red pill with amount `+$120` instead of small dot?
Elena: agree on pill. accessibility concern: the pill must have accessible name and be announced by screen readers. also color alone can't convey overdue state. add an icon or text like 'Overdue' that can be visually hidden but read by SR.
Owen: Design nit: the spend chart legend wraps badly at narrow widths. Proposal: condensed legend that shows 3 color swatches and "+2" overflow, opening a tiny popover with full keys on click. keeps height down.
Priya: I like the +N overflow. For tokens we should show compact units (e.g., 1.2M) in the rows and full raw tokens in tooltip. avoid mixing decimals and raw in the same row.
Dan: copy ask: change "Download invoice" button text to "Download (PDF/CSV)" so users know there are two formats. might be long for translations though.
Elena: alternate: show primary CTA as "Download" and a chevron menu next to it for PDF/CSV. that reduces text length and surfaces both options.
Owen: UX detail: keyboard order when collapsed must go: invoice row -> download CTA -> scope toggle -> chart. QA-bot flags keyboard trap around the legend popover if not careful.
qa-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) contrast for legend labels under 600px fails (target >=4.5:1). 2) org/project toggle missing aria-pressed semantics. 3) invoice badge lacks aria-label. 4) legend overflow popover not reachable via keyboard.
Priya: thanks QA-bot. I'll update the figma: 1) increase contrast, 2) add aria-pressed and aria-label="scope: org or project", 3) make pill include text "Overdue" visually hidden but SR-readable, 4) ensure popover is focus-trapped and closable with Esc.
Dan: measurement: can we run a 7-day experiment with `billing_ui_compact_exp` at 5% to measure "time_to_invoice_download" and "scope_switch_rate"? want to ensure collapse doesn't hurt findability.
Owen: dev TODO: implement telemetry events: `billing.invoice_opened`, `billing.download_selected(format)`, `billing.scope_changed`. Also flag to toggle condensed legend: `billing.legend_overflow`.
Elena: minor copy tweak: under spend chart add microcopy "Estimated monthly spend. Final invoice may differ." keeps expectations clear.
Priya: will push updated frames and a short QA checklist. Filing follow-up with annotated diffs and list of locales that need short translations for any button copy. thanks all :raised_hands:
